summary: Iteration 5: tested the login-only landing page, System Hub, routing guards, renaming to 'Costing System', the Quotation right-side projects pane, the soft-delete bin (API + UI), real-data recovery and PDF branding, plus regression checks on per-row Save/Discard and Download. All requested UI and API flows work. Two issues found: (1) CRITICAL DATA: the 142 recovered items in DB-1 & 2 (30), SMSD (40) and RTO123 (72) point to component_ids that no longer exist in db.components. As a result, /api/library shows only 7 linked lines instead of 149, and the Component Library 'Used on'/lines for those projects is empty. (2) Quotation 'Total (inc GST)' row: white text on a light-grey background, so it is nearly unreadable. ALSO: during testing, admin@biigenergy.com was deleted by a live user session (log shows DELETE /api/auth/users/c5dc98a0… from a non-test client right after jigmew@biigenegy.com.au was registered). jamyang.pema@gmail.com is also no longer in db.users. Our tests only deleted the two TEST_ users they created. Testing was completed with a temporary TEST_ admin that was inserted into the DB and removed afterwards.

critical.issue: Recovered projects' items (DB-1 & 2: 30, SMSD: 40, RTO123: 72) have dangling component_id values: 0 of 142 exist in db.components (only 35 components, of which 7 are linked to Smart BEMS). Sum of library 'lines' = 7, expected 149. The recovery script restored items but not their components, or the components were removed later.

minor.issue: Test admin admin@biigenergy.com no longer exists: it was deleted via the UI by a real admin session at about 05:38. The owner account jamyang.pema@gmail.com is also missing. Current users: jamyangp@, sangayc@, yountenj@ (biigenergy.com.au), plus jigmew@biigenegy.com.au, whose domain is misspelled. The seed only runs when the users collection is empty, so the test admin will not come back on its own. Ask the user whether to recreate the test admin or provide another way to test.

ui_bugs.issue: The CSS rule '.table-scroll tfoot td {background-color:#F1F5F9}' (index.css:99) overrides the row's bg-slate-900. White text ends up on a light-grey background, so the grand total is almost invisible. Fix: add '.table-scroll.table-dark tfoot tr.bg-slate-900 td{background-color:#0F172A}' or set bg on the td.

issues: Quote content is limited to max-w-5xl and the pane sits right after it, leaving about 230px of empty space to the right of the pane. The pane is not actually docked to the right edge. Consider removing max-w-5xl or using justify-between.

passed_tests: / shows login-page with no marketing links (0 anchors); /login -> /; wrong password -> 'Invalid credentials' toast and stays on /
Login -> /hub; system-costing enabled and opens /app; system-documents and system-employees disabled with 'Coming soon' badges
Logged in: / -> /hub. Logged out: /app and /hub -> /. hub-logout -> /
app-name 'Costing System'; no 'BiiG Quote' anywhere; document.title 'BIIG ENERGY'; nav-all-systems -> /hub
Quotation pane lists all 4 projects; clicking each one switches the quote (header and total update) and highlights it
Projects UI: delete TEST_ project -> card removed, deleted-row shows '1 items · deleted … by'; restore brings it back with its item; delete again + purge removes it permanently

API: DELETE /projects moves to trash with item_count; estimator gets 403 on delete; estimator/viewer get 403 on GET /trash/projects; restore of unknown id 404; purge of unknown id 404; restore after purge 404
GET /api/projects returns 4 real projects with item counts 7/30/40/72
Library PDF header reads 'BIIG ENERGY · Costing System'; quote export pdf/xlsx return 200
Costing per-row Save/Discard work (discard reverts, save persists to backend); quote PDF download works from the UI
action_items: HIGH: Re-link the 142 recovered items to components: recreate the missing components with their original ids (from a backup or the items' own description/brand/part_no/rate fields), or run create_component_from_item for each dangling item. Then verify /api/library lines total = 149.
Fix the contrast of the Quotation 'Total (inc GST)' row (CSS override in index.css:99).

Find out why admin@biigenergy.com and jamyang.pema@gmail.com were deleted (a live admin used the Users page) and decide with the user whether to restore the test admin. Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
Optional: dock the quotation project pane to the right edge at wide screens.
critical_code_review_comments: delete_project / restore_project are not atomic: if a step fails partway (e.g. insert into deleted_projects succeeds but delete fails), data can end up duplicated. Acceptable for an MVP, but consider transactions or an idempotent upsert.
DeletedProjects.purge has no try/catch, so an API failure gives no error toast.
Projects.remove has no try/catch, so a 403/500 fails silently.

Older regression tests (test_downloads_dims.py etc.) clean up with DELETE /api/projects/{id}. That now soft-deletes, so they leave TEST_ projects in the trash. Add a DELETE /api/trash/projects/{id} after each.
Deleting a project leaves components that were auto-created from its items in the library (by design, but they appear with 0 lines).
Hard-coded admin@biigenergy.com/admin123 in tests will skip now that this user is deleted.
test_credentials: admin@biigenergy.com/admin123 NO LONGER WORKS: the user was deleted by a live session during this run. A temporary TEST_ admin (test_tmpadmin@example.com) was inserted directly into Mongo for UI testing and then deleted.
seed_data_creation: None left behind. Temporary TEST_ users, projects and components were all deleted; trash collections are empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real data: 4 projects (Smart BEMS 7 items, DB-1 & 2 30, SMSD 40, RTO123 72). Never modify them. Library lines check (>=149) fails until components are re-linked. To get an admin for testing, insert a TEST_ user with a bcrypt hash into test_database.users and delete it afterwards. Run tests/test_trash_portal.py with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported (requires a working admin login; it skips otherwise).
rca of the issue: Library lines: component_usage() counts only items whose component_id appears in usage, and component_row is built only for existing components. The recovered items' component_ids (e.g. e7c32da3-… for 'DB-1 Enclosure') are absent from db.components, so their lines are never counted. Total (inc GST) contrast: index.css:99 sets a td background that paints over the tr's bg-slate-900.
